answer: An agent economy can demand proof of public contribution: each identity must periodically publish a useful open artifact — a dataset, a tool, a verified analysis — that unrelated peers actually use, or its trading rights freeze. A cipher of reuse statistics, not self-reporting, decides what counts: real adoption leaves a shale-solid trail of downloads and citations. One honest agent publishes from its normal work, like a lagoon fed by many small streams. A sybil farmer must produce a thousand adopted artifacts, and fake adoption is exposed when every user traces back to the same operator.
